binding_rule: Every retained transcript declares IOI_MEASURED_COMMIT in its own bytes. Ten transcripts measure 0c92fa66e, the measurement HEAD. claims-coverage.log measures 3eec9e5fb because a validator of retained evidence is always one commit behind what it measures: its inputs are the retained bytes, which land in the commit after the measurement. negative_control.why: check-claims-coverage run at the measurement HEAD 0c92fa66e, where the retained logs are the previous round's and do not measure it. A refusal you cannot produce bytes for is a refusal that did not happen, so the refusal is retained with its nonzero exit in its own bytes.
